_comment: Load-bearing fields of Hill90's platform-realm.json, extracted so this repo can
guard its vendored copy WITHOUT needing the Hill90 checkout present. CI here
cannot assume a sibling clone, so the comparison target is committed.
DO NOT HAND-EDIT. Regenerate:  python3 scripts/checks/check_vendored_realm.py --refresh
WHAT BREAKS THIS: upstream changing without anyone refreshing this file. The
guard then happily compares against a stale target. `--check-upstream` fetches
the live file and fails if this extract no longer matches it; run it on a
schedule or before trusting a green run after upstream work.
